text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They're all so damn strong. My legs're
still
tremblin'... But...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll do better—even better next time.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Did you see the way Air Shakur
just
glared at Opera O and the others?
Scary stuff.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing she held her own against
that lineup, though, don't you think?
There's something different about her
than when she ran the Japan
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: And, like, Opera O is just so on top of her game lately. Things are starting to feel kind of stagnant, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But if Shakur can inject new life into
everyone and set the stakes high again,
well... I'd sure like
to be there to see
how things turn out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smatterings of excited chatter drift over
to us,
but Air Shakur gives them no
attention.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Normally, people wouldn't put me on a
level anywhere near the big stars.
They're only including me in the gossip
'cause we all entered this particular
spring Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna do a complete overhaul on my
image,
I'm gonna have to grind 'em
under my heel.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that's exactly what I'll do next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto and Opera O are both goin' to the

Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is also known as
the spring Grand Prix. It attracts quite a
number of spectators and would be a
good race for
reinventing one's image.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, this is
about the
time people would start sayin'
I don't stand a
chance against them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But not this time. Let's give 'em
somethin' to
cheer about.
